extraction.Name: Nannie Childs Alley
extraction.Recorded patent: yes, filed for record; When Nov. 24, 1917
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: date of redemption expired? Mortgages paid off by Agency and lands deeded to minor children, with restrictive clause.
extraction.Occupation/Income: Allottee has no source of income, no contributions.
extraction.NOTES: Land was not sold to anyone; land was deeded to minor children of the allottee with restrictive clause after mortgages paid off by Agency. Has no funds accumulated. Good health. One minor child dependent upon her. Patent delivered at Otoe Agency; receipted for by allottee. Not defrauded — land deeded to minor children. Document notarized November 22, 1928, in Kay County, Oklahoma; Notary Public commission expires Aug. 3rd, 1931. Circular No. 2464, June 18, 1928.
